scope: Retained modeled bike/rider state initialized once, using explicit throttle, optional captured brake responses and external rider timing/gates. Visual emitter differences remain reported separately. Unmodeled bytes use each observed entry as an unchanged-within-call baseline. External rider output checks cover rider/child/global delta and, when captured, the retained particle pool. Pool differences from unconnected shared-world updates remain reported as visual differences; not all transforms/world allocations are checked. This is not full trajectory parity.
